They love each pet as if it’s their own and are beyond kind and caring to pet parents. In addition, they are geniuses in medicine,  assessing each patient and creating a care plan that is best suited for each and often times cutting edge. They are definitely leaders in the field of Vet Medicine and care.  While I would prefer a healthy pet, when in need of Vet care, MedVet is simply the best in every way.
Great facility
Staff and doctor were great, very caring and friendly.
ABSOLUTELY WONDERFUL & KNOWLEDGEABLE ANIMAL HOSPITAL WITH SOME OF THE MOST KINDEST STAFF IVE EVER SEEN !  I KNOW MY DOGS WILL BE WELL TAKEN CARE OF AT THIS FACILITY !
Dr. O seemed very knowledgeable and answered all our questions. Our dog seems like she's starting to feel a little better already.
Kind and friendly doctors; my baby was at ease! Very busy, lots of people trust them with their fur babies, which was a good sign.

Very professional and polite. Was very compassionate with our 13yr old Catahoula and let us know exactly what he did, and didn't, need. We were expecting he needed surgery, as our primary vet indicated, but they informed us we should just keep feeding him the Purina Pro Hydralized dog food and get another ultrasound in a few months to see if he might still need surgery. Thanks!

We've just moved here and my dog stepped on a bee and suffered a reaction. The whole team was so attentive start to finish, from the front desk to the wonderful med techs and the vet. It was a perfect welcome to Dallas! I highly recommend their services...even if I hope you never need them!

Unfortunately my dog had to be in the ICU at MedVet for 5 nights - not fun but I am so so thankful for the wonderful care she got. Every doctor and technician showed so much kindness and communicated very well.

I want to give a special shout out to Alex from the critical care team. He worked on my pup for several days and his care, kindness and knowledge was seriously impressive.  I visited my dog in the ICU and saw how skilled the technicians were dealing with oxygen, transfusions, etc. and I saw how they cheered for every tail wag a sick pup gave.

We first arrived at the ER at 3am and Jennifer who was at the front desk was amazing. She was so comforting and helpful. She even let us sit on a blanket to get our smell on it and then put it in the kennel so my pup had some comfort when she spent the night.

Also shoutout to Dr. Wheeler. He took a lot of time with me to explain his plan and what was going on. Every time he called his first words were that my dog is ok. True compassion to know how waiting even a few seconds to hear that can be torture.

I never want to have to take a pet to the hospital, but I would definitely go here if I need to!

Our experience with MedVet during our cat's treatment for lymphoma was exhausting and disturbing, and I want to be extremely clear: I am not angry because our cat died.

We knew he had aggressive cancer with guarded prognosis. We were never asking anyone to reverse biology. We were asking for evidence based medicine. Throughout his treatment there was a reflexive tendency to interpret criticism of care gaps as an inability to accept his prognosis. We knew he was going to die from the beginning. What we did not accept was allowing manageable sequelae to become crises, then using the resulting treatable crisis as evidence that it was time to euthanize him.

There were major gaps in their understanding of kidney disease in cats (which is common broadly in veterinary medicine). Even worse, we encountered knowledge gaps wrapped in absolute certainty presented with bluffed confidence. Many of the treatment decisions were not aligned with 2026 guidelines and much of the oncologist's practice felt robotic. Robot medicine is fine when care outcomes are good. It becomes questionable when it's 'this is the way I've always done it and I'm not changing course' and patients suffer needlessly.

Complex questions were funneled through techs who did not have the education or clinical expertise to field them. We spoke with Dr.McQuown for less than 45 minutes across three cycles of chemotherapy, three months and $30,000+ at MedVet. In each conversation, it was the same: she implied his long term prognosis meant he should simply "pass on" rather than provide any rationale for why receiving proactive palliative and supportive care was off the table. The response was always "are we just delaying the inevitable?" with no acknowledgment of current QOL status. Communication was always brief and incredibly reductive.

Critical care routinely failed to offer explanation for how they planned to distinguish decline from progression of his cancer from decline caused by another potentially treatable process and instead would use certain renal assays as 'proof' in isolation that he was becoming treatment resistant. There were constant handoffs and communication failures with basic errors and everything felt like somebody was passing the buck. There was very little consistency and we received radically different assessments from different criticalists (based on experience) that contradicted each other when no other variables had changed.

Criticalists also often attempted to provide education on oncology protocols they were not particularly qualified to answer and routinely gave incorrect information. And most of their clinical interpretations seemed to be based in subjective belief rather than objective medicine. On one occasion Dr. O'Conner cited a prognosis of a few good days where Dr. Williams the following morning informed us "months to years" both of these were foolhardy, neither were correct and neither should have been attempted.

Our experience with Juni looked like a case study in why the financialization of veterinary medicine is so toxic: massive specialty hospital, every machine imaginable, specialty prices, and somehow nobody owns the patient.

During one visit we were escorted to settle the bill while Juni was left unattended near an agitated, injured dog. Our payment details were on file and without any issues for tens of thousands of dollars at that point.

The oncologist wore so much fragrance we could smell her long before she entered the room. Avoiding strong smells is chapter one of clinical medicine, particularly in oncology.

Juni did eventually reach the end of his life, and we chose home euthanasia when supportive care could no longer give him an acceptable quality of life. I do not regret that decision. I regret the weeks we spent fighting for basic supportive care while every setback was framed as proof that we should stop.

The question was what his life looked like until then. And for too much of that time, MedVet made it harder than it needed to be.

I took my Corgi to MedVet Dallas to see Jess Rivera in Neurology. He was thoroughly evaluated and treatment options were presented and explained. I appreciated the range of options and recommendation to treat conservatively. They were very upfront with pricing. I was expecting them to do a full work up on our initial visit, but they advised of the high likely hood of repeating that same work up and the treatment recommendation being the same, regardless of the results of the work up on that day. They provided very detailed notes upon discharge so I knew exactly what was discussed and what I needed to do care for my pup.
Hello, thank you for the high rating! Big thumbs up!
Excellent and compassionate service
Every time I had an emergency? Dallas Med Vet has been there to take care of my kitties. I am really thankful with them as they always give me exceptional service.

While I am coming from emotional pain and hurt , I am trying to leave an honest review away from that bias. I came on an emergency referral from my vet and waited anxious hours with a full room of other crying owners. The first nurse that came to me was cold, seemed rushed, and disregarding. While I understand waiting is necessary for emergencies , the treatment and environment matters when you are worried about your fur baby.  Later while the emergency doctor was nice I could not receive any answers or even direction on the diagnosis. Again- I understand that I needed a specialist but they were unavailable so I had to worry all night until morning when the specialist called me . That is when I decided I hated to coming here . The doctor was monotone , seemed disinterested, first didn’t get my fur baby’s name right , but could not get the sex right .  I still offered them grace because of their job stress. But they did not give me any full explanation or hope - rather made it seem like  I should just “enjoy the time “. I got the tone we don’t know what it is but it is the worst an you are wasting your time and money. The final straw was on dismissal when none of the notes that were relayed to me by the nurse did not align with that we saw and even talked to ICU about when I was there in person to visit . The discharge notes still didn’t have my fur baby’s gender right , full of errors with paste and copy snippets from other discharge's . I went to another vet who blinked in disbelief at how poorly records were maintained.   The diagnosis doesn’t change but at least at another place I felt empathy and that they had the right animal. To an overworked , burnout worker maybe it’s just a pet (for many it is) . For me , and I know I’m not alone- they are your best friends who have carried you through some of the hardest times of your life. They are a peice of you. You feel what they feel. And even though you know the odds from the time you pick them up are against you, they for that time, are your world.  The least the business can do is figure out how to come at that lens in practice and not with just words on the wall.  I will say it’s 50:50 . I did meet some staff who helped me see my baby after hours and who dug deep to give their all . Names that stick out are Gray and Jennifer .  You can tell they are digging deep for that compassion and doing their best .  I will end by saying I’m coming from a place of having been there. I was a vet tech who couldn’t handle the weight.  That’s how I am also an aware of the many errors in communication.

Dr. Capaldo and the two techs that we visited with were nothing short of amazing. One of the most compassionate after care reports we've ever seen. The empathy & respect they all had for us was par-none. I would highly recommend MedVet. They were easy to work with on scheduling (even via text after some phone tag) and great updates via text as well. Very convenient when worrying about your four-legged friend.
I was a new customer, and received excellent service,very pleased.
So many stars! Fabulous; thank you!

The people at MedVet were incredible during one of the most difficult events of our lives.  They were so knowledgeable, so caring and gave us complete confidence throughout the process. I will never forget their compassion, generosity and expertise. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Thank you for taking the time to leave us this positive review! Lovely to see you had a great experience with us!

All the staff members at the Med Vet 24 hour Veterinary Animal Clinic were very kind and  loving to my elderly doggie. The  Doctor was able to diagnose, explaining clearly the cause of the medical emergency, and give treatment.  Lucas has been doing much better. The coordination of care with my regular Dr was efficient and timely. The care my pet and I received at the Med Vet Clinic was a Blessing to us both.  Thank you,
Hi, we love receiving a high rating, and appreciate your positive review! We hope you'll consider us again in the future!
We really appreciate this positive review! Thanks so much!

We take all reviews seriously, and would like to learn more about what we could have done to make this a better experience for you. If you are willing, you can reach out directly at (972) 994-9110. We sincerely hope to hear from you soon.
Thank you for taking the time to leave us this fantastic review! We strive to provide an excellent experience at MedVet Dallas. Thanks again!
The employees were friendly and I loved Dr Hartman!
Thank you, your positive rating means a lot to us here at MedVet Dallas!
Dr. Guevara in the neuro dept here is WONDERFUL! Thank you!
Great service!

We have had both of our senior labs down to MedVet Dallas and they have been wonderful. Most recent visit was with the oncologist for a chemotherapy checkup. The staff is wonderful and answers all questions and concerns.

Wonder emergency vet
Very kind professional
Wonderful doctors

MedVet provided truly exceptional care for my dog. Dr. Rogers, Dr. Hartman, and Dr. Encarnación all went above and beyond to give my dog the best possible treatment. I also want to acknowledge a gentleman who helped in the middle of the night during the emergency — I unfortunately don't remember his name, but in a moment that felt incredibly uncertain and overwhelming, he showed genuine compassion and let me see where my dog would be treated. His kindness and calm reassurance made a real difference. The entire team communicated with me every step of the way, and I'm so grateful to MedVet and everyone who cared for my dog.
MedVet is fantastic! Staff is 5 Star at all levels and they really care about animals. Highly recommend. If your pet is having an emergency just go to MedVet, don't hesitate!  Get on it!

Although our emergency had a sad ending, our experience with MedVet was the best it could have been under the circumstances. They were quick to address our pet's needs, clear about our choices, and kind in the wake of our loss. If you find yourself unfortunately needing emergency vet services, you and your furry loved one will be in good hands here.
While the wait was long, the doctor did a good job and discussed various treatment options.
Great staff great service from front desk all the way to Doctor taking care of my Coronel.
Thank you for your help.  Our dog got sick while traveling.   Y'all quickly triaged her, diagnosed her.   And she was bouncing back within 48 hours.  We are thankful.

Came here for my pup who was hacking all night so I immediately took him to the closest ER. Let’s start to say that I’ve been at other animal ER’s and I even WORKED in an ER for 7 years so I KNOW how this works. I’ve been to other pet ER and they always get us back within 30 min to an hour. I waited 3 hours for him to be seen. At first they took him back for god knows what, to just put a little band on his neck showing he’s a patient? They could’ve done that in the waiting room. Then they take us to a room and take him back 40 minutes later for an exam??? But then they come back and say the doctor will talk to me. I waited another 30 min for the doctor to come in and say… well we have no idea what’s going on, we could do an XRAY but we may not be able to do it for a while. So you expect me to wait 5+ hours while my dog is obviously uncomfortable so they try to take him back and they state they have 4 techs on him trying to do the XRAY and they wanted to charge us $450 and then out of ALL THE SIGNS HE WAS SHOWING YOU NEVER ONCE THOUGHT IT WAS KENNEL COUGH?? Like are you guys even professionals?? I’ve never even seen kennel cough but they should’ve know this straight away. Turns out he did have kennel cough from our NEW PUPPY. Don’t come here it’s not worth it. We still got charged $160 just for them to not do ANYTHING

Have been here multiple times and have always had the best service and experience. The communication has always been amazing and the staff is entirely so kind and caring about your pet. The neurology department is also great and so helpful with my pet’s epilepsy, I’m so thankful!

All office personnel and the vet doctor were very professional and friendly. Their expertise was very beneficial. We had 2 dogs that have been very sick for a couple of weeks. They immediately provided the help and support we needed.
We love stars! Thanks so much!

Medvet gave our dog his life back. We almost lost him in July.  He had surgery for a tumor at MedVet in Dallas and is now in oncology there. He has barely any side effects to chemotherapy.   He is a golden retriever, age 11, who is now acting like he is 3!   We could not be more pleased with the team of specialists- I will always come here if we need a specialty for our dogs.
Outstanding service as usual from the check in desk to heading out the door headed home. My miniature dachshund is doing much better 3 days later.
Hello, thank you for taking the time to leave us this great rating!
My dog swallowed a lump of foil covered cheese. Within an hour MedVet had my dog vomit it up and my border collie was saved. Every one was kind and took care of every thing so quickly.

Had a scary experience with a coyote attacking one of our pets in the early hours of Labor Day morning, and was so grateful that MedVet was open. He was in a lot of pain, and I would have driven him anywhere honestly, but I’m glad he ended up at MedVet. The dr who later called me for updates (Dr. Wheeler) spent a lot of time explaining what was found, offered me options for how to proceed, and gave really good advice - but the most impactful part was how he called; I answered the phone, and his first words were that my pet was doing well, and then said his name/facility name. Giving good news up front cuts out about 10 seconds of dread and panic for a pet owner, which is so kind. I was able to pay better attention to all of his info that followed because I wasn’t flooded with cortisol. I really appreciate all the extra care taken by the staff to make this a less terrifying experience.
Hello, thank you for rating us so highly! It is fantastic to see a rating like this!

My cat needed medical care that could not wait until my regular Vet could see her. MedVet Dallas even though very busy on the Sunday of long weekend was able to take care of her issue in timely manner, to be clear hours not minutes , but again they were very busy Sunday night and I am satisfied with the time and care my cat received.

My dog got bit by a snake and they took him in immediately and saved his life. It was on a holiday weekend so my regular vet was closed.  Dr. Ryder is very kind and explained the process so well. Greg was very helpful with getting everything coordinated. The ladies up front were very helpful in walking me through some of the paperwork.  I will definitely use this vet again.

Hello, we are happy to see that your experience has been a positive one! The team here at MedVet Dallas is always available for any assistance that you may need. Thank you for taking the time to leave us your rating!

Second visit with continued AMAZING care, teamwork, and kindness. It’s extremely stressful having to take my Matador to the emergency vet in general. Thank you for the excellent care you all provided him. I hope we do not have to visit again.
These ladies were great, quick and efficient. The Dr. explained everything very well and was very caring.
Always treat us well,

The staff tended to my pup & all of those who walked in with their pets so tenderly. They were courteous & quick with communication and provided sweet distractions for my little one as we waited in the waiting room! I walked out having the most positive experience amidst a hard day.
They saved my baby.  They are amazing and the vets there are on point
Hello, thanks for leaving us a great review! And, thanks again for choosing MedVet Dallas! Best regards!
Thank you for rating us so high here at MedVet Dallas!
Caring, empathetic staff who are also knowledgeable and efficient
Excellent care and compassion. They make difficult situations so much easier to deal with.
As always, everyone was polite. The process was smooth from check in to check out.
They are very good at everything they do. Very kind and supportive. Would recommend and I wouldn’t  change anything except the price
They were really incredible. The surgeon was the best. Her assistant was great. We couldn’t be happier.

We recently needed a surgeon for our dog.  Dr. Hastings and her medical assistant, Lupe, were amazing; as well as the rest of the staff at the surgical center.  Dr. Hastings was kind, patient and caring and explained in layman's terms what was going on with our dog.  We felt that he was in good hands.  Our pup is doing well and on the mend.
The nurses and veterinarian were very nice and efficient. She was very knowledgeable and helpful.
:-) Wow! Thank you for rating us so many stars!
This is absolutely the best Vet service you could ever go to. I highly recommend them they treat your pets like they are their own.
Hi, we appreciate your great rating! If you ever need anything else, we're available!
They took me and my dog as a walk in at 8pm, and gave us the best care! Every member of staff from the desk up to our amazing Vet was kind, caring, and excellent. Highly recommend
Hi, thank you for taking the time to rate us! We care deeply about delivering the best possible experience! Thank you!

The entire staff was supportive, friendly, and attentive to the whole family. The decision to hospitalize our canine family member was exactly what we all needed to ease our minds and hearts. I felt comfortable as I drove away that he was in competent and compassionate hands. I felt included and up to date throughout the experience. Thank you all!
Very sweet staff and great services provided!! They took great care of my fur baby 🐾 would recommend! …

I am deeply disappointed by the severe lack of follow-up care and communication from the internal medicine department at MedVet Dallas. My cat was on a 168-day course of prednisolone following FIP treatment. Today marked his final day of observation—a critical milestone where a structured steroid taper and safety blood work (to monitor for steroid-induced diabetes or kidney strain) are medically necessary. The internist completely failed to check in, provide a tapering schedule, or coordinate follow-up labs. Leaving a patient on long-term corticosteroids without guidance or safety monitoring is an unacceptable lapse in basic standard-of-care. Thankfully, the emergency veterinary staff provided far better responsiveness and competence than this specialist.
Bentley received extraordinary and compassionate care. The vets, technicians and staff were all amazing.

they were very thorough and actually seemed to genually care about my dog. I could only afford the initial exam, but I plan to come back once I have the money put together to get what my dog is needing

It’s not often that you want to leave a five star review for a place like a hospital. Usually, it’s not something good that brings you there. But no matter the reason, whatever brings your pet to MedVet, you can at least know that the people there will do everything in their power to take care of your fur buddy.

A lot of places say they treat your pets like their own, but this place really does. From the kind hearted folks at the front desk, to Gray, the technician who walked us through everything, and every doctor we spoke with — we felt peace of mind that our Chihuahua Minpin would be taken care of.

She came in with some pretty gnarly damage from a dog bite, and they cared for her as if she was their own. Her pain was managed, she healed as quickly as possible, and I got updates all along the way.

They are able to do x-rays and CT scans, and they have doctors on site 24-7.

I hope you never need to bring your pet here, but if you do, you can rest assured that they will give you the best experience possible. Thanks MedVet! My Goose is back home again 🐶

I cannot praise this staff enough.   My dog was in severe respiratory distress.  Every staff member was kind, compassionate and made saying goodbye to my baby a little easier.   They kept me informed and I am so grateful for their support.

I feel like they treated my dog as if it was their own and was very careful and sweet to them as well as treated them as they needed to get them well would highly recommend if I ever have the need to go back I for sure will choose them over any other!

We have had excellent veterinary experience and help with our baby, Pooh Bear.  She’s our dog who is a big part of our family.  We love her so much.  She was treated like family and loved by the staff.  Our pup is better since visiting MedVet.  With the proper treatment, she is getting back to her playful self again.  Thank you!

Very satisfied with the care and attentiveness to my dogs care. The entire team was very helpful in making sure any questions I had they assured me step by step of the process being done. Very caring and I will always take my dogs here for any emergencies with my primary vet being closed. Wonderful Team 🐶 …

I am overwhelmed by the compassion and kindness we were shown at MedVet. We worked with Dr. Joergensen, Dr. Ryder, Dr. Wililams and Dr. O'Connor - all were wonderful and gave us clear, easy to understand options for every problem we faced. The entire staff was great throughout a week of interaction and two surgeries for our pet. MedVet was very clear about each expense and no costs were hidden. They answered every call and every question quickly. I highly recommend MedVet

They take the time to listen and explain things. The vet wanted some labs and suggested I get them done at my vet because they might be cheaper. She waited while I called them when we were in the exam room.  They were almost 1/2 as much money so I had my vet do the labs and send them to her. I really appreciate that.
Very compassionate people.

Our dog was referred to y'all by our vet for possible gallbladder removal. Your staff was excellent; very caring. The Doctors explained his condition and treatment thoroughly and gave us clear options and associated costs. Fortunately his gallbladder did not need to be removed and your staff cared for him during his recovery.
Hello, thank you for taking the time to leave us this great rating!

Several years ago, my black Scottish terrier was bitten by a young copperhead. Out in the open but curled up under a small leafy branch. Other people walked through the area trail but Brodie was the only one to sniff at the tiny branch. It was evident that something out of the ordinary bit him on his nose. Brodie passed out. Bloody nose. It was a Saturday morning. I rushed him to MedVet and they immediately determined that he had snake toxin in bloodstream.
Brodie was kept for 4 days and treated.
I am forever thankful to the quick attention when I walked in screaming that my dog had been snake bitten.

I brought my girl in for IVDD, ruptured disc and paralysis. The staff was incredible. The wait time was nothing. Assessment was thorough and surgery was the same night. Communication from the staff throughout the process was phenomenal! Dr. Herrejon, Dr. Acevedo, Sierra and Anna- thank you!!!! I felt like my baby girl was taken care of and in the best place.

Excellent friendly staff and Vetinarian
Service. Really care about your pet.

When we had to unexpectedly bring our dog Daisy in, everyone at this clinic was very caring and helpful. Dr Angela Joergensen was amazing at explaining what was wrong with our baby in a way we could understand. She didn’t make us feel pushed into a corner or rushed. When we had to put our dog to sleep, you could tell that she felt what we were feeling. I will forever be grateful for the care she and the staff gave us and Daisy in a moment that way so quickly devestating for us - she offered a place to mourn and feel understood. We got our ashes back in a week as well which I appreciated greatly, I was ready to bring her home.
Very nice office and great staff. Got in quickly to see the Dr. and was happy with the care for our dog.

We took our French bulldog to the internal medicine specialist. She immediately suggested an endoscopy. The price came out to $3500 which was allot more than other places. I found this out later. When our dog was brought out from recovery he smelled like diarrhea and they hardly cleaned him. It then took me 2 weeks to get any answers. Our primary vet also called them several times. The communication was very bad between the vet and us. I would not recommend due to cost, the condition my dog was at pickup, and lack of response time.
Always great  vet care

We visited MedVet Dallas on Sunday with our dog for an emergency ultrasound. When we called ahead, the receptionist quoted us approximately $1,000 for the ultrasound. Unfortunately, the experience only went downhill from there. Dr. Williams had some of the worst bedside manner I have ever experienced with a veterinarian. There was very little indication of concern or compassion for what we were going through, and we were made to feel like nothing more than a number. Things became even more frustrating when a technician, Taylor, came in to discuss the charges and told us the cost was actually $1,500. When we asked about the $1,000 price we had been quoted over the phone, her response was incredibly sarcastic: “I don’t know why the receptionist keeps giving out the wrong information. They don’t make the prices, I do, and the price is $1,500.” The attitude was completely unnecessary and astonishingly unprofessional—especially in an emergency situation involving someone’s beloved pet. If there is a problem with your staff providing incorrect pricing information, that is something management should address internally. It should never be taken out on a distressed client. Our dog ultimately required emergency surgery. Given our experience with both Dr. Williams and Taylor, we no longer felt comfortable having our dog treated at this facility. We left and found emergency care at another hospital. When people bring their pets to an emergency veterinary hospital, they are often scared, stressed, and worried about whether their animal is going to be okay. Compassion, communication, and professionalism should be the bare minimum. Unfortunately, that was not our experience at MedVet Dallas.

I would absolutely NOT recommend this facility to anyone.

They took excellent care of my kitty with colitis symptoms. I felt better as soon as I walked in and talked with them, and she felt better by the time she left. She’s doing great now!

SPECIAL THANKS because I accidentally brought them the WRONG CAT at first - I wasn’t sure who was having bloody diarrhea, and my orange cat had it smeared on his foot so I assumed it was his. He has terrible vet anxiety and has to be sedated for exams, so I went home to try to relax while they did their work. I noticed a fresh spot of diarrhea that couldn’t have been him and called them immediately- they halted the sedation and swapped him with his black cat sister and didn’t even charge me for two intakes.

Lovely staff. You will probably be there on your worst day. They know that and they will help you. Try to be kind, they’ll take wonderful care of your pet.
Your great rating means a lot to us at MedVet Dallas, and we appreciate you taking the time to leave us this review! Take care!
It was a fortune could have definitely been cheaper but they saved my girl all that matters :)
Hello, thank you so much for the positive review! We will continue to do our best to earn it! Please don't hesitate to reach out to us if there's anything additional we can do for you!
We brought our pregnant dog Bella in who was in distressed. Everyone we came into contact including the doctor were all amazing and kept me calm while treating my baby.  She is doing well now.
The staff did a wonderful job communicating with us about our pup. They let us come visit him while he was hospitalized and truly prioritized providing the best care possible!
Great facility if emergency pet need or after hours.  Everyone we interacted with was great.
Thank you very much for the high rating! We hope to see you again soon!

My dachshund was just diagnosed with IVDD. I took him in for som acupuncture treatment. The staff were kind and the doctor was very thorough, empathic, and kind. He gave us some hope that our baby has a better chance of walking again than he had initially with the emergency vet. He answered all my questions and encouraged me to ask any questions I wanted. They’re very professional &, for a situation like this, the prices are very reasonable. I highly recommend them and I will continue to use them as well.
Excellent level of care and an attention to detail that left our family confident in MedVet taking care of our elderly dog after a bout with heat exhaustion.

Excellent surgeons. Referred to by another specialist who felt the condition was too complicated. MedVet performed surgery with no complications or issues and my pet was discharged the next day and he's doing great.

TLDR: COME HERE FOR YOUR PET EMERGENCIES! DR CAPALDO AND THE INTERNAL MEDICINE TEAM ARE AMAZING!!

I cannot  recommend this clinic enough. All of the staff and drs here really care about their patients and treat your animal like their own. My cat had been misdiagnosed and I was recommend to visit this clinic when my cat’s health declined. The internal medicine department helped give her a proper diagnosis and truthfully saved her life. Dr. Capaldo and her team were so wonderful. When test results came back it was the dr who called me not just a vet tech and the dr stayed on the phone with me until all my questions were answered something I had not experienced before. I felt so cared for and the team’s level of care truly gave me hope that my cat would get better. Be honest about budget, they were very understanding about cost constraints and will recommended what is the best course of action for your budget!

I have now been here twice. The people are very caring and upfront about everything. It’s a place you hope to never have to visit, but they do their best to make it the best experience given whatever circumstance brought you there. Thank you for showing such care to our Zeus and Ellie belly.

I really can’t say enough about Medvet Dallas. On Wednesday, I took my pup to our family vet because she got into the trash and ate stuff she shouldn’t have eaten. Our family vet recommended that we go to Medvet for further evaluation. My pup ended up having to stay two nights and I was so worried about my baby. The medvet nurses and doctors were exceptional. They called and gave me updates through the day, never did anything without communicating with me, let me come visit her whenever I wanted to, and treated her with the upmost care throughout her visit. She is now at home, resting comfortably, and happy as can be. Me and Loula Mae are so thankful for the Medvet team and Dr. Cline!

They did bloodwork, some numbers were off, they drained her belly fluid and left a terrible wound on her belly.  She also had a fever. Our 2-year-old Norfolk Terrier, Ralphie, underwent liver shunt surgery. Two days after surgery, he developed tremors that quickly progressed into focal seizures.

Our local emergency center veterinarians couldn't provide the level of care Ralphie desperately needed, so we made the frantic drive from Lubbock to MedVet in Dallas. We arrived at 1:30 a.m. on a Friday morning, and the emergency team was waiting for us. They immediately took Ralphie back and began treating him.

The doctors kept us updated every day, although the prognosis was very grim. Stopping his seizures proved to be more difficult than anyone expected. Dr. Williams eventually called with heartbreaking news—we were faced with the decision of placing Ralphie on a ventilator if we wanted to give him any chance of survival. Even with the poor prognosis, we didn't hesitate. Ralphie is family.

Despite being on seven different sedative and anti-seizure medications, he continued to have breakthrough seizures.

Three days into his hospitalization, Dr. O'Connor, the critical care specialist, took over Ralphie's case. She is brilliant and truly became our saving grace. She is an optimistic while also being honest about how critical his condition was. She carefully adjusted his medications, and for the first time, his seizures finally began to come under control.

Ralphie also received exceptional one-on-one care from his nurses, Esmeralda on the day shift and Micah on the evening shift. Unfortunately, we never had the opportunity to meet Micah in person, but she went out of her way to keep us informed. She even called us at 11:00 p.m. to let us know Ralphie had finally been extubated. That phone call meant the world to us.

Esmeralda took extraordinary care of Ralphie. We visited him every day and received updates from both Dr. O'Connor and Esmeralda. They were compassionate, professional, and genuinely caring. Esmeralda would talk to Ralphie and gently brush him, even while he was in a coma. Those small acts of kindness spoke volumes about the type of person and nurse she is.

Dr. O'Connor never gave up on Ralphie. She was determined to try every possible option to save him, and we trusted her completely. Every suggestion she made, we agreed to because we knew she was fighting just as hard for him as we were. She believed in him, and so did we.

After seven days at MedVet, Ralphie came home with us. We know that without the incredible doctors, nurses, and staff, he likely would not be here today.

We hope we never have another emergency like this, but if we do, there is nowhere else we would trust with Ralphie's life. Thank you, Dr. O'Connor, Dr. Williams, Esmeralda, Micah, and the entire MedVet team for giving our family more time with our sweet boy. We will never forget your compassion, dedication, and extraordinary care.
